views.title: Universal Keyboard Clipboard Manager & Media History

views.markdown:
### Never lose a copied snippet again.

**Yuna** integrates seamlessly into the native iOS keyboard dock, placing a convenient clipboard button right beside your emoji and dictation controls. Easily view, insert, and organize your clipboard history with support for **plain text**, **high-resolution images**, and **file links**.

#### Key Features:
- **Dock Integration**: Native clipboard trigger button in the iOS keyboard dock.
- **Universal Content**: Automatically captures text snippets, copied photos/images, web URLs, and file paths.
- **Pinning Engine**: Pin vital snippets to the top so they are never purged or overwritten.
- **Multi-Row Layout Management**: Configure 1, 2, 3, or 4 rows of snippets in settings to suit your workflow.
- **Direct Insertion**: Injects text directly into the active field without extra taps.
- **Rootless & PAC Safe**: Built for modern Dopamine jailbreaks on arm64 and arm64e (A12/A13) with ElleKit trampolines.

- **Zero UIPasteboard in SpringBoard**: Replaced the legacy private `UIPasteboard` IPC channel in SpringBoard with a loopback TCP + 64-bit Darwin state-ring bridge, completely eliminating iOS 16 "Home Screen wants permission to paste" prompts.
- **Reliable Copying & Zero-Loss Storage**: Added general-pasteboard scoping, re-entrancy guards, `NSItemProvider` / `setObjects:` hooks, and unsynced local item merging so sandboxed apps never lose copied items or cancel copies.
- **SpringBoard Leak & Loop Fixes**: Fixed `YunaPanelView` notification retain cycles, eliminated `UIKeyboardDockView` notify token leaks and `layoutSubviews` loops, and excluded system daemons and non-keyboard app extensions.
- **Clean Sileo Versioning**: Repository index now keeps only the newest package version per identifier.

- **Zero Paste Permission Prompts**: Eliminated background `generalPasteboard` queries in SpringBoard, completely removing the iOS 16 "Home Screen wants permission to paste" modal popup.
- **Unbroken In-App Copying**: Intercepts copied text, URLs, and images directly from copy method arguments inside foreground applications, preventing focus drops or copy cancellations.
- **SpringBoard Stability & Zero Restarts**: Switched SpringBoard daemon IPC to a dedicated private pasteboard channel on a background worker queue with thread-safe `UIGraphicsImageRenderer`, eliminating main-thread watchdog timeouts (0x8badf00d) and Jetsam memory kills.

- **Universal Storage Directory & Clipboard Persistence**: Fixed storage directory creation under rootless Dopamine by bundling Application Support/Yuna in the deb layout and adding robust 0777 permission setup in postinst. Sandboxed apps now seamlessly delegate pasteboard capturing to SpringBoard via Darwin notifications, ensuring reliable, universal clipboard saving across all apps.
- **Zero-Loss Storage & Safe Notifications**: Guarded in-memory clipboard items from being overwritten by failed disk writes or missing files, only broadcasting clipboard change notifications on verified disk writes.

- **Universal Cross-App Clipboard Sync**: Fixed per-app clipboard isolation caused by containerized CFPreferences. Migrated to unified rootless file storage (history.plist) with universal 0777/0666 permissions and a Darwin 64-bit IPC command fallback, guaranteeing instant, seamless clipboard synchronization across all sandboxed and system apps.
- **SpringBoard In-Memory Sync**: Connected SpringBoard's daemon to clipboard and mutation notification channels so pinning, unpinning, and deletions in any app immediately reflect in SpringBoard without desync.
- **UI Performance Polish**: Cached date formatter in memory and hardened root view controller traversal across active window scenes.

- **Instantaneous Sileo Installation**: Removed redundant shell maintainer scripts (postinst/prerm) to eliminate dpkg subshell stalls. Installation is now clean, instantaneous, and concludes with Sileo's native Respring prompt.

- **Interactive Tap & Paste Fix**: Resolved touch hit-testing in UIKeyboardLayoutStar and YunaPanelView, enabling instantaneous cell tap-to-paste, comfortable 36pt pin button hit targets, and dual direct-injection/clipboard syncing.

- **Reliable In-App Clipboard Capture**: Intercepts all pasteboard write paths in active processes and auto-synchronizes on dock tap, ensuring snippets transfer immediately even across sandboxed apps.
- **Touch Pass-Through Elimination**: Added strict hit-testing overrides on UIKeyboardLayoutStar and YunaPanelView to completely prevent touches in the clipboard panel from pressing keyboard keys underneath.
- **LiquidGlass & SpringBoard Stability**: Completely removed periodic timers and blocking main-runloop pasteboard IPC in SpringBoard, eliminating watchdog freezes and hitches when running with visual tweaks like Liquid(Gl)ass.

- **Native Sileo Respring**: Replaced abrupt script respring with native `cydia::respring` tag, displaying Sileo's native "Restart SpringBoard" prompt.
- **Dock Alignment**: Perfectly aligned clipboard icon with the language switcher row on the right side of the keyboard.
- **Package Artwork**: Added official character icon and depiction banner.

- Initial release in the Nishi repository.
- Universal keyboard dock clipboard button.
- Text, image, and file URL clipboard capture.
- Snippet pinning with eviction protection.
- Customizable row layout (1 to 4 rows).
- Native Sileo depiction and rootless Dopamine support.
